keyPoints.en: Nationalism = love for one's nation + the struggle to free and develop it.
keyPoints.bm: Nasionalisme = cinta akan bangsa dan tanah air + perjuangan untuk membebaskan dan memajukannya.

keyPoints.en: It grew in Europe, e.g. the French Revolution (1789) spread ideas of liberty and equality.
keyPoints.bm: Ia berkembang di Eropah, cth. Revolusi Perancis (1789) menyebarkan idea kebebasan dan kesamarataan.

keyPoints.en: Western imperialism in Asia made Asians want to rule themselves.
keyPoints.bm: Imperialisme Barat di Asia menyebabkan orang Asia mahu memerintah sendiri.

keyPoints.en: Turkey: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk modernised the country (Republic, 1923).
keyPoints.bm: Turki: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk memodenkan negara (Republik, 1923).

keyPoints.en: China: Dr Sun Yat Sen overthrew the Qing dynasty (1911).
keyPoints.bm: China: Dr Sun Yat Sen menggulingkan Dinasti Qing (1911).

keyPoints.en: Japan: the Meiji Restoration (1868) made Japan modern and strong.
keyPoints.bm: Jepun: Pemulihan Meiji (1868) menjadikan Jepun moden dan kuat.

keyPoints.en: India: Indian National Congress (1885); Gandhi used non-violence.
keyPoints.bm: India: Kongres Kebangsaan India (1885); Gandhi menggunakan kaedah tanpa kekerasan.

keyPoints.en: Indonesia: Budi Utomo (1908); Philippines: Jose Rizal.
keyPoints.bm: Indonesia: Budi Utomo (1908); Filipina: Jose Rizal.

tip.en: Make a table: country | leader / movement | method. Examiners love comparisons.
tip.bm: Buat jadual: negara | tokoh / gerakan | kaedah. Pemeriksa suka perbandingan.

keyPoints.en: Perak: Dato' Maharaja Lela — Birch killed at Pasir Salak (1875).
keyPoints.bm: Perak: Dato' Maharaja Lela — Birch dibunuh di Pasir Salak (1875).

keyPoints.en: Pahang: Dato' Bahaman and Mat Kilau (1891–1895).
keyPoints.bm: Pahang: Dato' Bahaman dan Mat Kilau (1891–1895).

keyPoints.en: Kelantan: Tok Janggut (1915). Terengganu: Haji Abdul Rahman Limbong (1928).
keyPoints.bm: Kelantan: Tok Janggut (1915). Terengganu: Haji Abdul Rahman Limbong (1928).

keyPoints.en: Sarawak: Rentap. Sabah: Mat Salleh and Antanom.
keyPoints.bm: Sarawak: Rentap. Sabah: Mat Salleh dan Antanom.

keyPoints.en: Causes: loss of power, new taxes, land rules and disrespect for local customs.
keyPoints.bm: Sebab: hilang kuasa, cukai baharu, peraturan tanah dan tidak menghormati adat tempatan.

keyPoints.en: Religion: Kaum Muda and the magazine Al-Imam (1906).
keyPoints.bm: Agama: Kaum Muda dan majalah Al-Imam (1906).

keyPoints.en: Education: SITC (1922) produced nationalist teachers and writers.
keyPoints.bm: Pendidikan: SITC (1922) melahirkan guru dan penulis nasionalis.

keyPoints.en: Press: newspapers like Utusan Melayu (1939) spread political awareness.
keyPoints.bm: Akhbar: akhbar seperti Utusan Melayu (1939) menyebarkan kesedaran politik.

keyPoints.en: Associations: KMS (1926), KMM (1938), state Malay associations and the Malay congresses (1939, 1940).
keyPoints.bm: Persatuan: KMS (1926), KMM (1938), persatuan Melayu negeri dan Kongres Melayu (1939, 1940).
